content.comment_body: Hello, I tried to install [product_name] on an HP laptop running Windows 7 64-bit Home Premium. I started with the [version_no] 64-bit demo taken from this site. The installation begins with InstallAnywhere, but after reaching the end, it disappears without any further action. I also tried the [version_no] version (not demo), which I have working on a desktop with XP 32-bit, but it also refuses to install on Windows 7. Any assistance would be appreciated.

Hello, Please try the following: Download the upgrade for [version_no] from [url]. Start the installation process. When prompted for the previous version's directory, insert the CD containing [version_no] and specify the directory \Windows\Tools\Application as a reference. Further details can be found at [url]. Regards,

Hello [user_name], Thank you for your response. I followed your instructions, but unfortunately, even the upgrade on my Windows 7 64-bit system halts after InstallAnywhere completes, with nothing appearing on the screen afterwards. Note: everything worked when I upgraded my XP 32-bit desktop. In the meantime, I've upgraded the Windows 7 64-bit HP laptop from Home Premium to Professional, but after trying all steps—both those I've described and those you suggested—the installation still stops after InstallAnywhere. I also tried fully uninstalling Java, restarting the laptop, reinstalling the latest Java version, and attempting [product_name] installation again, but the issue persists. Any further suggestions?
Hello, My recommendation is to submit a Support Request. That may help clarify this issue. Best regards, [user_name]

Many users have reported bugs with [product_name] setup, and I am unable to install it properly. I believe the software lacks development quality and hope the developers will address this in future versions.
There is a simple solution: Purchase a new disk with [version_no] and install it instead of attempting to upgrade a previous version. The cost is minimal compared to the time lost.
Did you also try this approach? [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users consistently encounter installation failures with [product_name] on Windows 7 64-bit systems. The process terminates at the InstallAnywhere stage, leaving no visible indication of progress. In contrast, installations work as expected on Windows XP 32-bit. Despite multiple troubleshooting steps including operating system upgrades, Java reinstallations, and attempted upgrade paths, the issue remains unresolved, suggesting compatibility problems and inadequate error feedback for 64-bit platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to install seamlessly on Windows 7 64-bit laptops and to receive clear feedback if problems arise during installation.
